title: Concourse console is reachable without authentication
description: The Concourse web interface is served without authentication. Concourse pipelines declare every credential reference, registry path and deployment target they use.
remediation: Enable the Concourse auth configuration for the web node and restrict the ATC port to the internal network.
limitation: One response body. The rule recognises the Concourse console shell from its document title; it does not attempt a login, so it shows that the interface is served, not which data the caller could read.

observation.body: <html><head><title>Sign in · Concourse</title></head><body><form method="post" action="/login"><input name="user"><input type="password" name="pass"><button>Sign in</button></form></body></html>
